title: Omnigent Task Board Report
description: JSCalendar Group of Tasks or single Task report accepted by PUT /v1/me/tasks/sources/{source_id} (RFC 8984 plus omnigent.ai: vendor properties).

UTCDateTime.description: RFC 8984 UTCDateTime in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.frac]Z form without trailing fractional zeros.

LocalDateTime.description: RFC 8984 LocalDateTime without a Z or numeric UTC offset.

AbsoluteURI.description: Absolute URI with scheme and no whitespace or control characters.

Waiting.description: Omnigent-defined structured block reason when the task is waiting.

TaskGroup.description: Omnigent-defined route, project, milestone or sprint grouping.

WorkedBy.description: Omnigent-defined session work interval linking a task to an Omnigent session.

SourceField.description: Omnigent-defined source-specific display field shown in the task detail drawer.

HistoryEvent.description: Omnigent-defined append-only timeline event for a task.

omnigent.ai:key.description: Omnigent-defined short display key (e.g. ENG-123 or owner/repo#12).

omnigent.ai:sourceState.description: Omnigent-defined raw status label in the source system.

omnigent.ai:resolution.description: Omnigent-defined raw close reason in the source system.

omnigent.ai:workedBy.description: Omnigent-defined sessions that worked on this task.

omnigent.ai:history.description: Omnigent-defined append-only timeline events for the task.

omnigent.ai:actions.description: Omnigent-defined explicit detail-card actions; never executed on task selection.

omnigent.ai:complete.description: Omnigent-defined completeness mode for the Group report.
